title: Fall 2026 Anagama Firing
source_quote:
Fall 2026 Firing Dates
Lottery Sign-up Deadline: July 27, 2026
Lottery Results Notification: August 4, 2026
Firing: Oct 9-11
Unloading: Oct 17
evidence_sentence: The page describes a three-day wood firing with an anagama kiln for 20–25 potters who load, glaze, stoke, and unload.
evidence_quote: The firing of the kiln over a three-day weekend provides potters with the unique opportunity to experience all facets of a wood firing.
summary: Wood-fire your bisqued pots in a historic anagama kiln over a three-day weekend. Participants glaze, load, stoke shifts, and help unload. Entry is by lottery; the deadline (July 27, 2026) has passed as of today.
commitment: Fri load · Sat fire · Mon unload; plus one stoking shift and help with wood
bring: Bisqued pots (at least 2000 cubic inches), Cone 10 clay and glazes (or use provided glaze)
cost_text: $125 participation fee includes up to 2000 cubic inches; 10¢ per cubic inch for additional pieces
how_to_join: Lottery entry; notification of results by August 4, 2026. Participation is not guaranteed.
